title: Testicular biopsy (TESE)
what: Through a small cut, the surgeon takes tiny pieces of testicle tissue and looks for sperm in them. The sperm can be used for IVF.
why: When there is no sperm in the semen and the couple is planning a child.
duration: surgery usually takes 30 to 90 minutes; you usually go home the same day
tell_doctor: Your medicines, especially blood thinners. The doctor will tell you what to stop and when
Past surgery on the scrotum or groin
If you or your relatives had problems with anesthesia

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests, an ECG, and sometimes a checkup with a general doctor. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: IVF clinic
prepare.text: The surgery is usually planned together with the IVF clinic, so the tissue can be frozen right away.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually no food from the evening before and no drinks for a few hours before. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: Underwear
prepare.text: Bring snug cotton underwear. It will support the scrotum after surgery.

steps: You change, and an IV line is placed in your vein
You get anesthesia or numbing medicine. Ask the clinic which
The surgeon makes a small cut in the scrotum
Small pieces of testicle tissue are taken
The tissue is checked right away and frozen for IVF
feel: Swelling and aching in the scrotum for the first few days
A bruise can happen and goes away
after: A cold pack on the scrotum, wrapped in cloth, for the first day, if your doctor allows
No heavy lifting or sports, usually for 1 to 2 weeks
No sex for as long as your doctor says
The clinic will tell you the result: whether sperm were found
red_flags: Severe swelling of the scrotum that keeps getting worse
A fever over 38°C or pus from the wound

faq.q: What if no sperm are found?
faq.a: This happens. The doctor will discuss other options with the couple.
Usually only a little tissue is taken. The doctor may check your hormones after surgery.

reminders.text: Testicular biopsy tomorrow. Bring documents and snug underwear. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
